question: Does the Target MAE definition measure the adverse effect on the Target and its subsidiaries "taken as a whole"?
options: Applies to Target and subsidiaries "taken as a whole"

question: Does the Target MAE definition include (as a separate prong) an adverse effect on the Target's ability to consummate the transaction / perform its obligations?
Is the "ability to consummate" prong of the MAE definition subject to the MAE carve-outs?
note: Answer "No" if the definition has no ability-to-consummate prong, or if the carve-outs apply only to the business/financial-condition prong.

question: Does the MAE definition contain a forward-looking standard (e.g., an effect that "would reasonably be expected to" have an MAE)?
Which forward-looking standard does the MAE definition use?
note: Answer "No" if there is no forward-looking standard.

question: To which prong(s) of the MAE definition does the forward-looking standard apply? (select all that apply)
note: Select only "No" if there is no forward-looking standard.

question: Do the MAE carve-outs use relational language (e.g., matters "arising from", "resulting from", "relating to" or "attributable to" the excluded events)?
Does the relational language apply to all MAE carve-outs or only some?
note: Answer "No" if there is no relational language.

question: Which relational phrases are used in the MAE carve-outs? (select all that apply)
note: Select "Relational language varies among carveouts" in addition to the phrases if different carve-outs use different phrases. Select only "No" if there is no relational language.

question: Which of announcement / pendency / consummation of the transaction does the deal-related carve-out cover? (select all that apply)
note: Select only "No" if there is no such carve-out.

question: MAE carve-out: actions required to be taken (or taken in compliance with) the merger agreement?
note: Answer "Yes" if the MAE definition (Target/Company MAE) excludes this category of events from what can constitute or be taken into account in determining an MAE.

question: MAE carve-out: actions taken (or not taken) at the request of, or with the consent or approval of, the Buyer?
note: Answer "Yes" if the MAE definition (Target/Company MAE) excludes this category of events from what can constitute or be taken into account in determining an MAE.

question: MAE carve-out: stockholder litigation/proceedings relating to the agreement or the transaction?
note: Answer "Yes" if the MAE definition (Target/Company MAE) excludes this category of events from what can constitute or be taken into account in determining an MAE.

question: MAE carve-out: matters disclosed in the Target's disclosure schedules (or disclosure letter)?
note: Answer "Yes" if the MAE definition (Target/Company MAE) excludes this category of events from what can constitute or be taken into account in determining an MAE.

question: MAE carve-out: actions taken by the Buyer or its affiliates (including breaches by the Buyer, or the identity of the Buyer)?
note: Answer "Yes" if the MAE definition (Target/Company MAE) excludes this category of events from what can constitute or be taken into account in determining an MAE.

question: MAE carve-out: the Target's failure to take an action that is prohibited by the agreement (e.g., under the interim operating covenants) where the Buyer withheld consent?
note: Answer "Yes" if the MAE definition (Target/Company MAE) excludes this category of events from what can constitute or be taken into account in determining an MAE.
